headline: Stellantis: Production of the 500 at Mirafiori Halted Again – What Are the Causes
summary: Production of the 500 at Turin's Mirafiori plant has been halted again, with workers placed under a redundancy fund. The reasons cited include a decline in electric vehicles and delays in hybrid technology.
why: Stellantis is a major global carmaker formed from the merger of Fiat Chrysler and PSA, and its Italian plants are central to its European output. Production stoppages affect its volumes and costs.
